# WO-270: Wider practice-mode wording guard (stays-on-device / never-contacts claims)
Status: open (GO in CLAUDE-063)
Vendor: codex
Kind: tests
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (check-ins via CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md)
Target release: v0.3.2 (test-only; does not block the tag)
Agent: Hannah Cole (test design with Amara Okoye), assigned by Nora
Source: Codex challenge CODEX-149 #5, accepted in CLAUDE-062; test design from CODEX-150
Numbering: WO-236..265 are reserved for the batch being written in parallel, so this one is WO-270.

## Goal / acceptance criteria
Extend `tests/codex/test_cx_app_practice_wording.py` so that, within one copy unit that makes a practice-mode claim, it also rejects:
- "your information stays on this computer" / "stays on this device" (while searching)
- "none of your information leaves this device" / "nothing leaves your device"
- "never contacts any site" / "doesn't contact any site"
Practice-mode searches still contact people-search sites, so these are false in that context.
- Keep the positive controls passing: "no removal requests go out until you say so", "Practice mode still searches sites; no removal requests are sent", "nothing is sent to us".
- Scope as CODEX-150 proposes: flag only when the copy unit also makes a practice-mode claim, so accurate storage statements elsewhere ("your details are stored on your computer, encrypted") are not flagged.
- Synthetic bad and good fixtures for each pattern. Keep every existing pattern and case: the guard gets wider, never looser.
- If current app copy trips the new patterns, add a strict xfail naming file:line plus a finding in VENDOR_STATUS.md. App copy is front end (in-house): do not edit `src/`.
- Windows-safe: no POSIX-only path handling.

## Allowed paths
- `tests/codex/test_cx_app_practice_wording.py`
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Required checks
- `PYTHONPATH=$PWD/src ../../.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/codex/test_cx_app_practice_wording.py`
- `../../.venv/bin/ruff check tests/codex`
